messages:
kevin_pm: quick sync: propose we formalize onboarding gates + pin terms. aim = predictable comms for customers.

maria_prod: agree. need 1-pager for sales.

josh_eng: technical blockers: quant variants and cache behavior. require infra mapping step.

olga_research: sampler: 3k stratified queries, median cosine + answer_overlap + hallucination heuristic.

kevin_pm: draft gates: PASS if cosine_shift <= 0.02 AND overlap >= 95% AND hallo_delta <= 0.4%. PASS -> 1%/24h canary. WARN -> 0.5%/48h. FAIL -> block.

tara_sre: add alert when hallo_delta > 0.25% during canary. also cooldown: block same variant for 7 days after rollback.

nate_cs: pin windows: enterprise 90d, mid 45d, self-serve 21d. sales can request exceptions with a migration plan.

maria_prod: i'll draft comm + sales intake.

josh_eng: i'll spike onboarding job to emit a report + auto-flags. PR planned next week.

kevin_pm: next: olga -> thresholds sweep; josh -> spike; maria+nate -> comm + contract text. reconvene Thu. :rocket:
